concepts.label: Index Replicas (FTS availability feature)
concepts.note: No prior registry term; supports availability by promoting a replica partition to active if the Index Service-node hosting the active partition is lost.

notable_absence.finding: No privilege documented for configuring the number of index replicas - same gap as other fts/ index-configuration and index-management pages in this batch.

competency_questions_addressed: How do index replicas support availability in the Search service?
How many index replicas can be configured, and what limits that number?
What privileges are required to configure index replicas?
